name: sgrd-masale
description: SGRD Masale — full-stack storefront (React/Vite web + Express API + MongoDB).

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix web && npm run lint --prefix api
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix api
